narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Ninety degrees counts as obtuse, so the right corner can be one of the two obtuse corners.
<bookmark mark='line'/>Look at the strip. A corner of ninety degrees sits on the line between acute and obtuse.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>It is a right angle, a quarter turn, and obtuse angles must be wider than that.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says ninety degrees counts as obtuse; a corner of exactly 90° is laid on the strip and sits on the line between teal and amber, in neither shaded part; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check the figure, hold a right angle against each corner in turn.
<bookmark mark='count'/>You should find three narrower corners, one the same, and two wider ones.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: compare every corner with a right angle

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says ninety degrees counts as obtuse, so the right corner can be one of the two obtuse corners. A right angle is exactly a quarter turn and an obtuse angle is wider than that, so the bubble is struck.
